## Definition of Done
- [ ] Every acceptance criterion in the linked issue is met
- [ ] Reviewed and approved by a teammate (not the author)
- [ ] Verified by someone other than the author (note below what was checked)
- [ ] Automated tests added or updated, and CI is passing
- [ ] No sensitive patient information in logs, code, or test data
- [ ] README or runbook updated if behavior, setup, or support steps changed

## If this is a defect fix
- [ ] Root cause noted in the issue
- [ ] Regression test added that fails without the fix

## If this is maintenance or production support
- [ ] Tested in staging before production
- [ ] Rollback or recovery step documented
- [ ] Affected clinics informed, if needed

## If this is technical work (CI, logging, dependencies)
- [ ] Setup or usage instructions documented
- [ ] Team informed of any change to how they work
